artifacts.summary: 6-phase, 7-hour plan: promote `scope excursion` into the seed enum and reconcile the count across 10 files, add grouping-time case/separator folding plus an empty alias table to the aggregator's jq pipeline, reject repeated `--tasks` with the flag audit recorded, give `class` a shape convention and append-time warnings, add 10 regression cases, then redeploy and re-verify against the deployed copies.

memory_candidates.content: Core's shell regression suites resolve their subject script deploy-tree-first, so a source-store edit under agent-system/extensions/core/ is INVISIBLE to them until a redeploy -- a suite run before the deploy is a vacuous pass on the stale deployed copy. lib/common.sh's common_test_resolve_subject honors a CORE_TEST_SUBJECT_MODE=source-store environment override for exactly that case (it overrides only the deploy-tree-first PREFERENCE, never a hard `deployed`/`source-store` caller), and the suites copy the resolved script into a scratch .claude/scripts/ tree so deploy-root-guard.sh still passes. Verified live: test-orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh runs 15/15 green against the source store with no deploy. Planning consequence: source-store script edits do NOT need a deploy per phase to be verifiable -- export the override in each pre-deploy phase and re-run the suites once in default mode after the final deploy, which is also what distinguishes a real green from the vacuous one.
